headline: Robust H1FY27, guidance revised upward

highlights: (ARVINF ) CMP: ₹ 602 Target ₹ 845 (40%) Target Period: 12 months November 9, 2026 Robust H1FY27, guidance revised upward… About the stock : Arvind SmartSpaces (ASSL), is the real estate arm of Lalbhai group, which has a 120-year legacy.
On earnings front, consolidated revenues for Q2FY27 at ₹ 157 crore up 12% YoY (-51% QoQ), EBITDA margins up 1410 bps YoY (- 1413 bps QoQ) at 35.1% and net profit up 26% YoY (-82% QoQ) at ₹ 18 crore.

Investment Rationale: • Strong H1FY27 performance, prompts upward revision in guidance : The company has received a robust response to project launches and healthy sustenance sales of ₹1338 crore helping H1FY27 presales reach 86% of FY26 presales of ₹1550 crore.

Consequently, the company has revised its pre-sales guidance upwards to ₹2600-2700 crore in FY27 while keeping its longer-term pre-sales growth guidance intact at 25- 30% YoY. • Strong business developments during H1 FY2 7; balance sheet remain under levered : The company added three new projects having cumulative GDV of ₹ 3100 crore (~62% of annual guidance).
valuation: (ARVINF ) CMP: ₹ 602 Target ₹ 845 (40%) Target Period: 12 months November 9, 2026 Robust H1FY27, guidance revised upward… About the stock : Arvind SmartSpaces (ASSL), is the real estate arm of Lalbhai group, which has a 120-year legacy.
Rating and Target Price : • We retain our BUY rating with a revised Target Price of ₹ 845/- on project NAV basis (factoring newly acquired projects).
Valuation We value ASL on project NAV basis for its ongoing, completed and upcoming residential projects.
